# How to Confirm and Locate the Source of a System Call in ros_control Real-Time Threads When Hard-to-Soft Transition Occurs?

> **Current answer:** The thread uses the `/proc/rtai/scheduler` file in RTAI to observe if a system call occurs in the real-time thread, and then narrows down the source by commenting out sections, recompiling, and re-running. The original author identified the issue at `ros::Time::now()`.
